_readme: Allow-list for scripts/check-wiring.mjs (gate G4). An entry means a src/data value export is unreachable from any screen and is deliberately kept. Every entry must carry a real reason. The gate also fails on a stale entry (one that has become reachable), so the list cannot silently accumulate. Per docs/BRANCH-MAP.md the inert set in src/data/** is Builder B's to resolve; this branch builds the gate, records the finding, and does not build in another builder's scope (rule 5).
_builder-b: Builder B's per docs/BRANCH-MAP.md ('The export sits in src/data/** ... Builder B'). Recorded here so the gate can pass without this branch re-implementing B's resolution. The owner sees the list; it is not silent.
_a-own-unwired: This branch's own data export, built for a feature whose screen was not finished. Reported in docs/SCALE-TASKS.md as a wiring gap; wire it or hide the surface.
